# Psalm 139 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the choir director. A psalm of David. LORD, you have examined me and you know me inside and out.

**2** You know when I sit down and when I stand up. You understand what I'm thinking even from far away.

**3** You observe my travels and my rest; you're familiar with everything I do.

**4** Before I even say a word, LORD — you already know exactly what it is.

**5** You surround me — behind and in front — and you place your hand on me.

**6** This kind of knowledge blows my mind; it's too high for me to grasp.

**7** Where could I go to escape your Spirit? Where could I run from your presence?

**8** If I fly up to heaven — you're there. If I make my bed in the grave — you're there too.

**9** If I ride the wings of the sunrise to the farthest ocean,

**10** even there your hand will guide me; your right hand will hold me tight.

**11** If I say, 'Maybe the darkness will hide me; let the light around me turn to night' —

**12** even the darkness isn't dark to you. Night shines like day; darkness and light are the same to you.

**13** You created every part of me; you knit me together inside my mother's body.

**14** I praise you because I am amazingly and miraculously made! Your works are incredible — I know that with everything in me.

**15** You watched my bones being formed as I was made in secret, carefully put together deep in the earth.

**16** You saw me before I was fully formed. Every day of my life was recorded in your book before a single one had begun.

**17** God, your thoughts about me are so precious! There are so many of them!

**18** If I tried to count them, they'd outnumber the grains of sand. And when I wake up, I'm still with you.

**19** God, if only you would destroy the wicked! Get away from me, you murderers!

**20** They speak about you with evil intentions; your enemies misuse your name.

**21** LORD, shouldn't I hate those who hate you? Shouldn't I despise those who defy you?

**22** I hate them with absolute hatred; I consider them my enemies.

**23** Search me, God, and know my heart! Test me and know my anxious thoughts!

**24** See if there is any hurtful way in me, and lead me along the everlasting path.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **139:7-12**: You can't outrun God. Not in heaven, not in the grave, not in the farthest ocean, not in the deepest darkness. This isn't surveillance — it's love. There is nowhere you can go where God won't find you.

- **139:13-14**: 'I am amazingly and miraculously made.' This is the Bible's strongest statement about human worth. You're not an accident, a mistake, or a random event. You were carefully, intentionally crafted by God himself.

- **139:23-24**: The psalm that began with 'You know me' ends with 'Search me.' That's the response of someone who has realized that God's knowledge isn't threatening — it's healing. Invite the examination.

— PNEUMA
